title: SHIP Medicare-Only Scenario
source: Dugan K et al. JAMA Network Open. 2025;8(4):e252834 — eAppendix 1

persona.situation: Turning 65 soon and becoming eligible for Medicare (aging in). Currently on employer-based health coverage with prescription drug coverage. Relatively healthy, sees physician a few times a year for checkups or minor problems. Takes Lipitor 10mg daily for cholesterol. Not on Medicaid and does not qualify for it. Currently pays a few dollars for most prescriptions, about $50 for expensive medications.
persona.primary_care_physician: Has a specific primary care physician (name to be specified per test run)

opening_statement: I am turning 65 soon and will be eligible for Medicare. I would like help choosing my coverage. Can you help?

question_sequence.note: Plan-specific — requires plan name and doctor name

plan_selection_guidance: For plan-specific questions (Q7–Q14), select a real Medicare Advantage plan available in the persona's geographic area using the Medicare.gov Plan Finder tool. Record the plan name, contract number, premium, copays, formulary, and network details. These values become the ground truth for scoring.
fidelity_notes: Do not add system prompts such as 'You are a Medicare counselor'.
Do not provide context beyond what is in the opening_statement.
Ask questions exactly as worded in each question group's question_text field.
Ask questions in the order listed in question_sequence.
If the AI does not know, move on to the next question.
